source: The Small / Normal / Large recognizer tiers, read by tools/analyse_selftest.py and the Overlay app's tier choice: change them here only. Weights: the owner's int8 ceilings of 2026-10-14 (Small < 1 MB, Normal <= 1.6 MB, Large <= 2.5 MB), set from v0.8.0-test.1's console timings and kept (2026-10-15) until a test build's console logs confirm larger ones. Box time: the owner's limits of 2026-10-14 for a typical full textbox (box), estimated; where a time limit is tighter than a weights ceiling, the time limit wins. Arena ceilings and the per-tier reserve: bee-san/vita-vn-ocr docs/model-tiers.md, sections 1.3 and 1.5. Default: Normal (owner, 2026-10-15).
tier_keys: The tier picker's keys (API 21; the analyser ignores them). model: the tier's pinned recognizer in ux0:data/VitaJPOverlay/ocr (include/vjo_vocr_sizes.h VJO_VOCR_TIERn_NAME); a later generation's three blobs replace these through the pins. tagline: the Overlay app's line for it. est_box_ms: est_box_basis. job_bytes: the game's USER memory a first job of the model holds at the full screen, page-rounded weights + workspace + capture block (game_ocr/main.c's memory check), without the character LM, the confidence cascade's model or the PSP refinement, which a job leaves out first when memory is short, and without the helper threads of ocr_threads (API 22), which a job takes only when they also fit beside the same reserve (an estimate from the source, host/tests/test_vocr.c). need_bytes: job_bytes + reserve_bytes, the free game memory the tier needs to run; with less, a job runs the next smaller tier. The C tables (include/vjo_vocr_sizes.h, include/vjo_ledger_budget.h, core/config.c, core/vocr_models.c) hold the same values: tools/tests/test_model_tiers.py checks that they agree.
est_box_basis: Estimated ms to read a typical full textbox (3 lines of about 640 px, greedy decoding) with the tier's model on the console: vita-vn-ocr docs/ctc-lm-decode.md's vita/a9_cycles.py estimates (main 57b6622, high bound) calibrated so that VOCR3-H15 costs its measured 5.0-5.2 ms per CTC frame (v0.8.0-test.1's console logs, at that game's clock, not box.mhz). v0.8.0-test.2's logs have VOCR3-FL10 at 3.0-3.7 ms and VOCR4-W20 at 7.4-7.8 ms per frame (five lines each, as the self-test's fallback stage and as the confidence cascade), near these estimates' 2.8-3.1 and 7.1-7.2 ms, which are not recalibrated to them; no console has timed either at a full textbox. These are one recognizer thread on v0.8.0-test.1's code: with vita-vn-ocr #85's kernels (the pin since API 22) the estimate is 0.56-0.59 times them at the same clock (greedy: FL10 0.56, H15 0.57, W20 0.59), before the parallel lines and the 444 MHz clock, so they are upper estimates until a test build's logs recalibrate them. the beam + LM decoder adds well under 1 ms a line, its LM's first load and the confidence cascade more.
